newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KLINSMANN SET TO RETURN TO SPURS, PAPERS SAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN SET TO RETURN TO SPURS, PAPERS SAY.

text.p: German international Juergen Klinsmann is set to return to English premier league Tottenham, the club he quit two seasons ago, according to reports in British Sunday newspapers.
The Sunday Mirror said Klinsmann was ready to sign a two-year deal which would also involve a coaching role.
Klinsmann walked out on the London club amid considerable acrimony after just one season in order to return home to play for Bayern Munich.
The Mirror quoted club sources as saying Klinsmann and Tottenham chairman Alan Sugar have since settled their differences.

"It's the worst kept secret at Spurs that Klinsmann has signed up. Everybody is talking about it at the club and we all know he's been over here in the last week looking for a house," the source said.
The News of the World quoted Klinsmann as saying he would make a decision soon.
"I will decide my future in a few weeks -- but England has a fascination for me and I would have no problems playing for Tottenham again," he was reported as saying.
